title: Kiosk Pickup Rebuild
lede: Pickup moves onto the task scaffold: blue for a personal pickup, violet for a shared case, Undo on every scan, off-plan scans answered inline, and a receipt that names what stays reserved.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Before = HEAD 1417e3c0 build, after = working tree; same created simulator, same fixture scenarios.

pairs.title: Pickup, nothing scanned
pairs.beforeCap: Progress ring, readiness badge, rail with its own title block.
pairs.afterCap: Scan prompt in blue, context card, 'Picking up 0 of 4' list with the battery row, Pick up pill.

pairs.title: Reservation with 10 batteries
pairs.beforeCap: Battery-quantity card repeated the any-unit rule; rail row said ANY UNITS.
pairs.afterCap: One battery row: '0 of 10', 'Numbers are saved as you scan them', no fake slot numbers.

sections.heading: New frames (after only)
sections.note: No before exists for these states: the old screen had no inline cards, no Undo, no shared styling, and no pickup receipt card.

shots.title: F1 · battery #12 picked up
shots.cap: Blue confirmation with Undo; list shows #12 filled and an outlined chip still to scan.

shots.title: F2 · MIC-12 isn't on this reservation
shots.cap: Inline card; Put it back / Add MIC-12.

shots.title: F3 · swap in a replacement
shots.cap: MIC-11 can take MIC-09's place; Swap for MIC-09, Put it back, or add as an extra.

shots.title: F4 · shared travel case
shots.cap: Violet section, 'For the team', Pick up for the team, off-record hint.

shots.title: F5 · receipt
shots.cap: Leftover line in amber: 'MIC-09 and 1 × Sony Battery stay reserved for a later pickup.'

changes.was: Adaptive split with ring and readiness badge; no Undo.
changes.now: Task scaffold, blue section, battery chips filled when scanned and outlined while still to scan, Undo on each confirmation (pickup scan DELETE).

changes.was: System dialog 'Add this item?' with Discard.
changes.now: Inline card with Put it back / Add MIC-12.

changes.was: Unreachable: the scan route never sent a substitution.
changes.now: Scan route offers a like-for-like swap (same category or name); card offers Swap for MIC-09, Put it back, or add as an extra. Same-model suggestion list dropped (class d).

changes.was: Same blue screen as a personal pickup.
changes.now: Violet section, 'For the team' list, 'Pick up for the team' pill, off-record hint.
Receipt card with scanned tags, due time, and an amber leftover line from confirm remainingItemNames.
Asks first: 'MIC-09 and 1 × Sony Battery aren't scanned' / Keep scanning / Pick up 3.

verification: xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk build (created iPad Air 11-inch (M4) iOS 26.5): pass
npx vitest run tests/ios-kiosk- + kiosk-pickup-substitute + kiosk-pickup-add: 20 files, 69 tests pass

notes: Fixture captures prove rendering only. Undo, substitute, and confirm against a live server, plus scanner/camera/sound on hardware, are unverified.
Undo is withheld after an item is added to the plan or swapped in (clearing the scan would leave it reserved); the row's Remove is the way back.
F2 says 'It's free' without a date: the preflight returns no free-until time.
